conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Karan Mehra. Mere account mein ek unknown transaction hua hai ₹5,000 ka.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Karan ji, yeh sunke sorry laga. Kya aap apna account number aur transaction date bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Account number hai 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 0 1 2 3 4, aur transaction kal ka hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Main check karta hoon. Yeh ek unauthorized transaction lagta hai. Main ise block karta hoon aur refund process shuru karta hoon. 7 din mein update milega.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Please jaldi karo, yeh pareshan karne wala hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Ji, main priority pe handle karta hoon. Aapko update deta rahunga. Koi aur sawal?
